name: Chaperone
description: Fills in missing parental ratings for music (Deezer), movies & shows (TMDb), and anime (MyAnimeList) so parental controls work across the whole library.
overview: Automatic parental ratings across music, movies, shows, and anime.

versions.changelog: After its scan, Chaperone queues a Jellyfin library scan so folder-level parental filtering picks up the new album/artist/track ratings automatically (previously required a manual 'Scan Media Library').

Label unidentifiable tracks with a configurable rating (default 'Unrated') so nothing is left blank; rate all artists TV-G to keep artist browsing working when 'block unrecognized rating' is enabled (documented workaround); album rating, album-inheritance, and artist rating are now toggles.
Third fallback: a track that neither Deezer nor MusicBrainz can identify inherits its album rating, so unmatched tracks are no longer left unrated when the album has a rating.

Rate music albums (derived from tracks, least-restrictive) so parental controls no longer hide album/artist containers that lack a rating; music is browsable for restricted users again. Music rating fields are now dropdowns.
Initial release: Deezer-first music ratings (ISRC fallback), TMDb movie/show certifications, MyAnimeList anime fallback, and a manual full-library scan task.
